title: Armstrong Number
description:
Given an integer `n`, return `true` *if and only if it is an **Armstrong number***.

The `k`-digit number `n` is an Armstrong number if and only if the `k^th` power of each digit sums to `n`.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Armstrong Number.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
